itens.titulo: Nokia Sinks 9% on Q3 Beat as It Holds Outlook, Cuts Cash Flow View: “Growth Is Accelerating”
itens.descricao: Nokia Sinks 9% on Q3 Beat as It Holds Outlook, Cuts Cash Flow View: “Growth Is Accelerating” Yahoo Finance
trechos: Key Takeaways - Nokia shares fell 9% today.
Third-quarter revenue of €5.15 billion beat estimates, and comparable EPS of €0.09 matched them.
- Nokia is putting an extra €400 million into working capital this year so it has supply for 2027, when it expects Optical and IP Networks to grow 25% to 30%.
- Nokia also lowered its 2026 free cash flow conversion assumption to 35%-55% of comparable operating profit, down from 55%-75% in July.
- Even after today's drop, Nokia trades well above its five-year average forward P/E, so the 2027 growth has to show up.
Nokia (NOK) sank 9% today after a third quarter that beat on revenue.
CEO Justin Hotard also said that "growth is accelerating." The problem is what Nokia is spending to keep that growth coming.

itens.titulo: TSX futures point lower following Meta, Tesla earnings
itens.descricao: TSX futures point lower following Meta, Tesla earnings Yahoo Finance
trechos: By 07:37 ET (11:37 GMT), the S&P/TSX 60 index standard futures contract had fallen by 13 points, or 0.6%.
On Wednesday, the S&P/TSX composite index finished higher by 0.6% at 36,324.99, notching its highest closing level since September 22.
By 07:50 ET, the S&P 500 futures contract had fallen by 78 points, or 1.0%, Nasdaq 100 futures had dropped by 514 points, or 1.7%, and Dow futures had retreated by 298 points, or 0.6%.
